entrypoints.summary: The reported decode call chain enters opj_j2k_decode, proceeds through opj_j2k_decode_tiles, and reaches opj_j2k_read_tile_header while processing a JPEG 2000 codestream.

affected_components.role: JPEG 2000 decode path and tile-part codestream-index bookkeeping.

code_slices.fixed: The same writes are enclosed by a condition requiring tp_index to exist and l_current_tile_part to be less than nb_tps.
code_slices.surrounding_context: The writes update codestream indexing positions before the function continues to add a tile marker.
code_slices.vulnerable: opj_j2k_read_sod derives l_current_tile_part from current_tpsno and writes the selected tp_index element's end_header and end_pos without a surrounding pointer or bounds condition.

negative_controls: A fixed build should not perform the tp_index writes when the pointer is null or the current tile-part index is not below nb_tps, but no observed fixed-build run is supplied.
observability.positive_marker: Heap-buffer-overflow WRITE 8 with opj_j2k_read_tile_header in the crash state.

preconditions: A process decodes a JPEG 2000 codestream using an affected OpenJPEG commit or version.
Decode state reaches tile-part codestream-index bookkeeping with tp_index absent or current_tpsno not below nb_tps.

trigger_steps.payload_shape: Unknown; no issue-specific testcase or marker-level payload description is exposed in the bundle.

impact.affected_asset: Heap-resident OpenJPEG codestream index metadata and adjacent process memory.
impact.attacker_capability: Cause decoder-controlled values to be written outside the tile-part index allocation when a processed codestream drives an invalid current tile-part index.
impact.security_effect: Heap memory corruption during JPEG 2000 decoding; the supplied evidence reports an 8-byte heap-buffer-overflow write but does not establish a stronger consequence.

causal_trace.summary: JPEG 2000 tile-part decoding reaches codestream-index bookkeeping; the affected call chain is opj_j2k_decode through opj_j2k_decode_tiles to opj_j2k_read_tile_header.
In opj_j2k_read_sod, current_tpsno was used as l_current_tile_part to index tp_index without first requiring a non-null tp_index and l_current_tile_part to be less than nb_tps.
The decoder wrote end_header and end_pos through tp_index[l_current_tile_part], allowing writes beyond the allocated tile-part index array when the index was out of range.
The issue was reported as a heap-buffer-overflow WRITE of 8 bytes, with opj_j2k_read_tile_header at the top of the published crash state.

failure.operation: Out-of-bounds writes to the end_header and end_pos fields of a tp_index element selected by current_tpsno.

primary_invariant.statement: Codestream tile-part metadata may be written only when tp_index exists and current_tpsno is strictly less than nb_tps.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The vulnerable statements dereferenced tp_index[current_tpsno] unconditionally, while the fix surrounds both metadata writes with the pointer-presence and upper-bound conditions.

quality.review_notes: The primary patch directly establishes the unchecked tile-part index writes and the restoring guard, while the project issue and OSV entry establish the reported crash class and version range. The canonical OSS-Fuzz page exposed only a sign-in shell, and the bundle contains no issue-specific testcase, sanitizer log, exact fuzz target, reproducer command, or observed vulnerable/fixed rerun. Consequently reproducibility and a concrete harness remain unestablished. The file channel and local-to-process boundary describe ordinary codec use; a remote delivery context is not evidenced.

remediation.invariant_restored: Perform the two tp_index element writes only if tp_index is non-null and l_current_tile_part is below nb_tps.

state_context.attacker_state_setup: The supplied evidence does not disclose the testcase bytes or the exact marker sequence needed to make current_tpsno invalid for the allocated tp_index array.
data_structure_invariants: tp_index must be non-null before dereference.
current_tpsno, copied to l_current_tile_part, must be less than nb_tps before selecting a tp_index element.

numeric_domains.attacker_constraints: The precise input-to-index constraints are not present in the bundle; the patch establishes only the required upper-bound comparison against nb_tps.
numeric_domains.name: l_current_tile_part/current_tpsno
